name: unnamed-fill-through-a-ternary
find:
let findings = PaintedSurfaces.captionFindings(stale: caption.findingsAreStale)
            Text(summary)
                .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(findings.ink)
                .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                .padding(.vertical, 3)
                .background(Capsule().fill(findings.badge))
replace:
let findings = PaintedSurfaces.captionFindings(stale: caption.findingsAreStale)
            Text(summary)
                .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(findings.ink)
                .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                .padding(.vertical, 3)
                .background(Capsule().fill((caption.findingsAreStale ? Color.warmMid : Color.roseDeep).opacity(0.12)))
breaks: a fill goes back to a colour chosen by a ternary at the point of use, which the rule could not see because it looked for the literal text .background(Color. and a condition sits between the bracket and the colour (#600)
